lesson.menu_desc: Order a real Italian dinner and explain what you can and cannot eat -- 35 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 27 -- Italian Dining
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Marlene Landucci | Lesson 27 -- Italian Dining
lesson.grammar_point: dietary needs: I am allergic to ... / I can't eat ... / Does it have ... in it? / without + noun

listenings.text: Hi Marlene, it is Giulia from Hotel Firenze. You asked me about a good place for dinner tonight. I recommend Osteria del Ponte, near the old bridge. It is small, but the food is wonderful. You should try the pasta with tomato and basil. It has no meat, and it is not spicy. Be careful with the pesto, because it has nuts in it. I know your friend Paul is allergic to nuts. The fish soup is famous, but it has a lot of seafood, so it is not good for everybody. If you cannot eat something, just tell the waiter. They can make many dishes without cheese or without gluten. The osteria opens at seven thirty. Enjoy your dinner.

Good evening, and welcome to Osteria del Ponte. Tonight we have three specials. The first is spaghetti with clams and shrimp. It is our best seafood dish. The second is a vegetable risotto with mushrooms and parmesan cheese, so it has dairy in it. The third is roast chicken with potatoes and a little red pepper. It is a bit spicy. All our pasta has gluten, but we also have gluten-free pasta. We can make it for you in fifteen minutes. If you have an allergy, please tell me before you order, and I can check every ingredient with the chef. Enjoy your evening.

extra_audio.text: First, you sit down at the osteria and the waiter gives you the menu. Then you say that your friend Paul is allergic to nuts. Next, you ask the waiter if the pesto has nuts in it. After that, you order the pasta without cheese. Finally, you try the dessert and you say it is delicious.
